items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I was singing with Paul Gaten up there.

ctx.x: It's a good message, wasn't it? Yeah. Good message, yeah.

I know all of you that were of this colored song she they called. What's she called this girl? I don't get it. What's she singing? Yeah. I was singing with Paul Gaten up there. Anna Lara. Anna Lara. Yeah, for Anna Lara. Well, you know what she did? She rang me up one night. They had a band from Texas. When, at Gaspar's place. Yeah. Little man on Bourbon Street. Yeah. And she was on the show. And he had the band in charge because the band from Texas was off. And Anna Lara got up there to sing. And she broke time.…
She been looking back at the band.
